name: Big Valley District-Lake County

known.via: English Wikipedia "Big Valley District-Lake County AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Clear Lake sub-area on the southern shore of the lake, covering the flatter valley floor north of Kelseyville. Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay, Viognier and Riesling are the main whites, while Zinfandel, Merlot and Cabernet Franc lead the reds.
